subject: The Welcome Project Immigrant Assistance Fund
overview: Anna Callahan hosted Kenia Alfaro of The Welcome Project to discuss the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on local immigrant families. Alfaro outlined the organization's relief efforts, language services, and the Immigrant Assistance Fund providing aid across several municipalities.

items.title: Overview of The Welcome Project
items.summary: Director of Parental Engagement Kenia Alfaro outlined The Welcome Project's mission and programming, including adult ESOL classes, youth interpretation programs, and community organizing across Somerville, Medford, and greater Boston.

items.title: COVID-19 Impacts and Food Access
items.summary: Alfaro described how pandemic shutdowns created immediate job losses, rent concerns, and grocery access barriers for immigrant families, prompting referrals to school meal distribution and local mutual aid networks.

items.title: Immigrant Assistance Fund and Multilingual Outreach
items.summary: Alfaro reviewed the Immigrant Assistance Fund, which provides direct financial aid and resource navigation to immigrant households in Somerville, Medford, Cambridge, Everett, and Malden through multilingual intake in Spanish, Portuguese, and Haitian Creole.

items.title: Volunteer Needs and Mask Mandate Outreach
items.summary: The discussion covered volunteer needs for digital media and supplies, alongside outreach efforts to inform immigrant families who do not receive municipal alerts about Somerville's mandatory public mask order.

items.title: Donation and Program Information
items.summary: Alfaro provided details on contributing to the relief fund and accessing organizational resources at welcomeproject.org.
